summary: Backend-only verification of three completed AI-tool enhancements PASSED end-to-end against the public preview URL (https://multilingual-text-2.preview.emergentagent.com). 10/10 pytest cases green in 19.8s. Synonyms('happy') → 6 lines all in `word | short meaning` format (e.g. 'joyful | feeling or showing great pleasure and happiness'). Antonyms('happy') → 6 lines same format (e.g. 'sad | feeling or showing sorrow or unhappiness'). NO numbering, NO bullets, NO surrounding quotes — frontend split-on-'|' will work cleanly. Grammar('He go to school yesterday.') → suggestions[0] = 'He went to school yesterday.', data.explanation = 'The sentence uses the time marker "yesterday", which requires the simple past tense. The irregular verb "go" must be cha…' (non-empty, multi-sentence English rationale), data.examples = exactly 3 short native-speaker sentences. Grammar idempotent test (already-correct input) also returns valid structure. Idioms('break the ice') → 6 short real-life sentences across registers (workplace, casual, networking) with ZERO numbering/bullets/blank-lines. Vocab('resilient', target=Tamil) → meaning_translated is in Tamil script (no Devanagari fallback), meaning_transliterated is pure Latin (Tanglish). Vocab_full('resilient', target=Telugu) → full schema verified: idioms_phrases (exactly 3), tenses {past, present, future} each with english+translated(Telugu)+transliterated(Latin), synonyms ≥3, antonyms list present, all 'translated' fields in Telugu script (no Devanagari). Chat ('What is grammar?') returns natural prose (not JSON), reply length OK, persisted to db.chat_messages. Guest auth + /auth/me both return tool_uses_today & tool_uses_limit (10) correctly. No code changes required — all three requested enhancements work as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: TOOL_PROMPTS['synonyms'] and ['antonyms'] (server.py:704-715) correctly enforce `word | definition` format with explicit 'NO numbering, NO bullets, NO quotes' — Gemini 3 Flash complies on first try.

TOOL_PROMPTS['grammar'] (server.py:567-583) returns JSON with corrected/explanation/examples and the endpoint (server.py:891-905) safely parses + falls back to plain text if JSON malformed. data.examples capped at 5 entries (line 900) but prompt asks for exactly 3 — capping is defensive.

TOOL_PROMPTS['idioms'] (server.py:716-722) produces 6 clean lines reliably; multi_tools set (server.py:889) correctly routes idioms through _parse_numbered_list which also strips numeric/bullet prefixes — double safety.

_vocab_payload_valid + script-aware retry (server.py:815-829, 911-942) is robust: confirmed Telugu/Tamil now stay in their native scripts and don't fall back to Devanagari. No retry was triggered in either of my Tamil/Telugu test runs (model nailed it first try).

/api/ai/chat (server.py:959-1002) still works independently of /api/ai/tool — chat is plain prose, not JSON. Frontend correctly never invokes the tool endpoint from chat, so synonyms/antonyms cannot leak into chat (requirement #2).
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway guest users (one per pytest module-scoped fixture run, plus the one-off sanity-check script). One chat session 'test-iter7-chat' written to db.chat_messages. No persistent users / no whitelist changes / no subscriptions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_ai_tools_v2.py is the canonical regression suite for the three AI-tool enhancements. Run with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep ^EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) pytest backend/tests/test_iter7_ai_tools_v2.py -v`. Module-scoped guest fixture creates 1 guest, then runs 8 /ai/tool calls + 1 chat call = under FREE_TOOL_DAILY_LIMIT (10). If you increase test coverage that triggers the limit, create one guest per class or use admin token. The synonyms/antonyms response parser in frontend (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx ~440-535) splits each line on '|' — confirm this is preserved if you ever change the parsing branch in server.py:945-949. Grammar 'data' field shape is { explanation: str, examples: list[str] } — frontend must read data.examples not suggestions[1:].
